title: 'What will we have left if we stop loving summer?': Heatwaves crush France's season of insouciance

title: Natalie Massenet and Erik Torstensson: A fiery romance torn apart by a courtroom battle
subhead: 'Sewn and torn' (4/5). Love stories and friendships can sometimes end badly, even in the world of fashion. But in 2025, when Natalie Massenet accused her partner of infidelity and fraud, their glamorous affair turned sordid.
